# Pokémon Redstone: Co-op Edition

**A single-file, browser-based Pokémon × Minecraft fan game, now with room-based co-op, live text chat and peer-to-peer voice chat.**

## ✨ New features

<table>
<tr>
<td width="50%" valign="top">

### 🎮 Co-op rooms
Host a room from **START → CO-OP** (or **JOIN CO-OP** on the title). Share the 5-letter code or an invite link (`?join=CODE`). Up to **4 players**. Friends in the same world see each other on the map with name tags.

</td>
<td width="50%" valign="top">

### 💬 Live text chat
Press **T** anywhere in the world, type, press **Enter**. Messages appear over the game for a few seconds and are rate-limited against spam.

</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top">

### 🎤 Voice chat
Real-time **peer-to-peer** voice (WebRTC mesh). Toggle your mic with **Y** or the 🎤 button, mute everyone with 🔊. A green dot shows who is speaking.

</td>
<td valign="top">

### 📦 One file, no server
Code, art, maps and co-op are all packed inside **`index.html`**. Double-click it or host it on any static host (GitHub Pages, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages).

</td>
</tr>
</table>

## 🚀 Quick start

1. Download **`index.html`**.
2. Open it in a modern browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari). Double-clicking is enough for solo play.
3. For co-op with friends, put the file on **HTTPS** hosting (see [Deploy](#-deploy-on-github-pages)) so the microphone is allowed.

### Start a co-op session

| Step | Host | Friend |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Open **START → CO-OP** | Open the invite link, or **JOIN CO-OP** on the title |
| 2 | Enter a name, click **HOST A ROOM** | Enter a name and the 5-letter code, click **JOIN** |
| 3 | Share the code / **COPY INVITE LINK** | Both click **🎤 MIC** to talk |

Pick the **same world** (e.g. Classic Kanto) to see each other on the map. Chat and voice work no matter where everyone is.

---

## 🎛️ Controls

| Action | Key |
|---|---|
| Move | `Arrows` / `WASD` |
| Mine / attack / talk | `Z` (hold) |
| Use / place / eat | `X` |
| Jump · Sprint · Sneak | `Space` · `Shift` · `Tab` |
| Inventory · Menu · Map · Music | `E` · `Enter` · `J` · `M` |
| **Text chat** | **`T`** (Enter sends, Esc closes) |
| **Microphone on/off** | **`Y`** or the 🎤 button |

Keys can be rebound from **CONTROLS** on the title screen. The chat key follows that binding.

## 🌐 Deploy on GitHub Pages

1. Create a repository and add `index.html` (and this `README.md`).
2. **Settings → Pages → Deploy from a branch →** `main` / `(root)`.
3. Share `https://YOUR_USERNAME.github.io/YOUR_REPO/`. GitHub Pages is HTTPS, so the mic works.

<details>
<summary><b>How co-op works (technical)</b></summary>

<br>

- **No game server.** The host's browser runs the room. Players connect through the public **PeerJS** broker (loaded from a CDN on first use) and then talk to the host over a WebRTC data channel.
- **Messages** (join, chat, positions, mic state, WebRTC signalling) use one small JSON protocol. The host relays them.
- **Voice** is a WebRTC **mesh**: every player sends audio directly to every other player (fine for up to 4). Signalling rides the same room channel.
- **ICE:** Google STUN, plus a free public TURN relay as a fallback for strict networks (best effort).
- **Optional own server:** in the co-op panel under **Advanced** you can enter a `wss://…` address of a compatible WebSocket room server instead of PeerJS.
- **Packaging:** all JavaScript modules and assets are gzip+base64 inside `index.html`, unpacked at start, wired up with an import map, and served from memory (`fetch` and image loading are intercepted).

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>Troubleshooting</b></summary>

<br>

| Problem | Fix |
|---|---|
| "No room with that code." | Check the code. The host must keep their tab open. |
| "Could not load PeerJS" | Co-op needs internet the first time (CDN). Check ad-blockers/firewall. |
| Mic button shows an error | Use **HTTPS** (or localhost) and allow the microphone in the browser. |
| Can hear nobody | Click once on the page, check the 🔊 button is not muted, try another network (strict NAT/VPN). |
| Friends don't appear on the map | You must be in the **same world**, and on the same map area (indoors vs outdoors). |
| Blank screen / "could not start" | An ad blocker blocked a file. Allow the page or use a private window. |

</details>

## 🔧 What I changed

Compared with the original download:

- ➕ **Added** co-op rooms, invite links, 4-player limit, name tags and avatars.
- ➕ **Added** live text chat (`T`) and peer-to-peer voice chat (WebRTC) with speaking indicators.
- ➕ **Added** a serverless transport (PeerJS) and an optional WebSocket room server mode.
- ➖ **Removed** the sponsor banner, the email sign-up form and the analytics script.
- 🛠️ **Fixed** source files where `?.` and `??` had been split into `? .` / `? ?`, which made the scripts fail to parse.
- 📦 **Repackaged** everything into one self-contained `index.html`.

## ⚠️ Known limitations

- Co-op currently shares **presence, chat and voice**. Mobs, blocks, battles and saves are **not** synchronised between players: each player simulates their own world.
- The original generated-world menus and some optional assets were not part of the files I started from, so the game runs in **Classic Kanto** mode.
- Voice over strict NATs depends on the public TURN fallback and may fail on some networks.
